description: Minimal ws-compatible client shim for the Mas Golfs integration harness. Backed by Node 24's built-in WebSocket client (stdlib only, no npm install). Implements exactly the surface nodecg-bundle/extension/index.js uses: new WebSocket(url), .on('open'|'message'|'close'|'error'), .send(string), .close(). NOT a production dependency — never copy this into the bundle.
name: ws
